answer: Each submission hangs on the relic of a task receipt, and the falcon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the kernel of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, expired if not renewed by fresh work. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
